name: sqrt_one_add_norm_sq_le
result.informal_description: For any element $x$ in a normed additive commutative group $E$, the inequality $\sqrt{1 + \|x\|^2} \leq 1 + \|x\|$ holds, where $\|x\|$ denotes the norm of $x$.

name: Real
sqrt_one_add_le
result.value:
:= by
  refine sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
  calc
    1 + x
    _ ≤ 1 + x + (x / 2) ^ 2 := (le_add_of_nonneg_right <| sq_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring
result.informal_description: For any real number $x$ satisfying $x \geq -1$, the principal square root of $1 + x$ is less than or equal to $1 + \frac{x}{2}$.

name: Real
sqrt_le_one
result.value: := by rw [← sqrt_one, sqrt_le_sqrt_iff zero_le_one, sqrt_one]
result.informal_name: Square Root of $x$ ≤ 1 if and only if $x$ ≤ 1
result.informal_description: For any real number $x$, the principal square root of $x$ satisfies $\sqrt{x} \leq 1$ if and only if $x \leq 1$.
